name: 33068 · N Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33068 (N Lauderdale) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33068 (N Lauderdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33068 (N Lauderdale) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
